items.asset_inspection: 1528x1749 RGBA PNG, transparent background. It is the light-appearance 'mascot' droplet layer of the Icon Composer bundle DroppyCode/Resources/AppIcon.icon (referenced by icon.json as layer name 'mascot ', image-name 'mascot (3).png', glass-specialization true for default/light, opacity 0 for dark and tinted appearances, position scale 0.5 / translation (0,36)). Visually: a single teardrop-shaped droplet with two oval white 'eyes' punched out near its base, rendered with soft internal shading (a bright highlight on the upper-left lobe, a darker gradient toward the lower-right) so it reads as a glossy/glass droplet mascot, surrounded by a soft white outer glow/halo. Between B2 and B3 the file's byte size changed from 614192 to 592376 bytes (git diff confirms a binary content change, 0 text lines by construction) with no dimension change; the droplet's fill color shifted from a lighter cyan-blue tone toward a more violet/periwinkle 'ultramarine' blue, matching the CHANGELOG.md B3 entry 'The app icon, the Droppy logo in Settings and the website's icons wear Droppy's new ultramarine blue' and the companion edit to DroppyCode/Resources/AppIcon.icon/icon.json's default fill-specialization linear-gradient, which moved from display-p3:0.56863,0.76863,1.00000 / srgb:0.14510,0.50196,1.00000 to srgb:0.51765,0.52549,0.96471 / srgb:0.07059,0.09804,0.92941.
